_comment: Display mode profiles. Monitor identity is by EDID (edidMfr/edidProd, hex) - stable across reboots and port swaps. friendlyName is informational only. positions are virtual-desktop pixels relative to (0,0).

work.description: Acer (top) is the main display at (0,0); MSI (bottom) is disconnected/turned off.

personal.description: MSI (bottom) is the main display at (0,0); Acer (top) is extended above it (current layout: 420px right, 1440px up).
